d: Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

On an exclusive island in the heart of the Kingdom’s capital, Four Seasons Hotel Bahrain Bay, with its unique architecture, has become an iconic landmark that soars as a destination in its own right, combining the best of a beach holiday and an urban getaway.

The Director of Housekeeping is responsible for leading and managing all housekeeping operations throughout the hotel, ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness, service, safety, and presentation.

This role oversees guestrooms, public areas, laundry operations, uniforms, and housekeeping administration while fostering a culture of excellence, employee engagement, and continuous improvement. The Director of Housekeeping plays a key role in delivering the exceptional guest experience synonymous with Four Seasons.
q: Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
Minimum of 8-10 years of progressive housekeeping leadership experience within luxury hotels or resorts.
Proven successful experience as a Director of Housekeeping in a luxury hotel environment, with candidates currently holding the same position and operating at the same professional level.
Strong knowledge of housekeeping operations, laundry management, budgeting, labor planning, and quality assurance processes.

Proven leadership skills with the ability to motivate, coach, and develop large and diverse teams. Demonstrated ability to lead through managers, make independent decisions, and drive departmental performance.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
Strong financial acumen with experience managing departmental budgets and productivity target.
Proficiency in hotel management systems and Microsoft Office applications.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.
Fluency in English required; additional languages are an advantage.
r: li
Provide strategic leadership and direction to the Housekeeping Department, ensuring alignment with Four Seasons standards and service culture.
li
Oversee the daily operation of guestrooms, public areas, laundry, uniform room, and linen management.
li
Ensure all guestrooms, suites, public spaces, back-of-house areas, and employee facilities are maintained to the highest standards of cleanliness and appearance.
li
Lead, coach, develop, and inspire housekeeping managers, supervisors, and team members to achieve operational excellence.
li
Conduct regular inspections and quality audits to maintain luxury standards and identify opportunities for improvement.
li
Manage departmental budgets, labor costs, payroll, inventories, and operating expenses while maximizing productivity and efficiency.
li
Collaborate closely with Front Office, Engineering, Residences, Food & Beverage, and other departments to ensure seamless guest experiences.
li
Monitor guest feedback, online reviews, and satisfaction scores, implementing corrective actions as required.
li
Drive employee engagement initiatives, training programs, and career development opportunities within the department. Supports departmental succession planning and leadership growth
li
Ensure compliance with Four Seasons policies, local regulations, health and safety requirements, and environmental sustainability initiatives.
li
Develop and maintain preventive maintenance and deep-cleaning schedules for guestrooms and public areas.
li
Manage vendor relationships and procurement of housekeeping supplies, equipment, and operating inventories.
li
Lead departmental projects, renovations, and opening initiatives when required.
li
Support emergency response procedures and business continuity plans.
li
Promote a positive, inclusive, and professional work environment focused on teamwork and service excellence.

d: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We build internal systems to the same standard as our public products: specified, tested, reviewed and observable. We want engineers who enjoy that rigour and take full ownership of what they ship.
q: Treat testing, security, performance and accessibility as part of the job
Handle sensitive people data with care
Write clearly and work well in a distributed team
Own your work from first spec to production
Nice to have: Python, Go, React, Svelte, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, a history of building tools for HR, finance or operations.

The ideal candidate will use their passion for experimentation and analytics to build tomorrow’s tech organisation. This team will help us gain insights into the business and our talent pool, and use those insights to improve the experience of working at Canonical.

As a Workplace Engineer at Canonical, you need an analytical, data-driven mind and a passion to connect and make sense of interesting data from APIs. We focus heavily on the collection of metrics, optimising processes, and ways of working across Canonical. You need to demonstrate leadership, excellence, and consistency and will mentor others in the team.
r: li
Design and deliver systems and platforms, including intuitive UIs
li
Build Go services and APIs that connect many data sources
li
Design data models and architecture for connected systems
li
Turn data into clear dashboards and visualisations
li
Build LLM-powered features into everyday workflows
li
Write specs, estimate work and deliver to agreed criteria
li
Set a high bar in code review, testing and documentation
li
Partner with non-technical colleagues to turn needs into tools
li
Mentor engineers and improve how the team works
x: We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
